description: Astra probe 1: the R1 versions of S4 10x10_dense_1 and D3 10x10_dense_deadend_ky_dy_1 (goal (8,8)), R1 cell verbatim, same Astra settings as the R1-frontier run.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_model_params: OpenAI reasoning models reject temperature/top_p, so none is sent (the temperature key is absent on purpose). max_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens and covers reasoning + visible output, matching the Claude/Kimi R1 64k cap. image_detail=high so the maze render is not downscaled to the 512px low-detail tile. service_tier=flex bills at Batch rates ($5 in / $0.50 cached / $25 out per 1M for gpt-6-astra, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing 2026-09-12); flex capacity misses return 429 (not billed) and are retried with backoff — max_attempts=30 rides out a flex/TPM storm instead of ending the episode as agent_error. spend_cap_usd is a per-worker-process hard stop (reset on restart) — pair it with an OpenAI project budget limit. Calibration (2026-09-12): the one-maze Astra probe measured 295 mean output tokens/query, projecting the panel at $16-34 flex across the calibration/Opus-R1/Kimi-R1 queries-per-episode scenarios; a stress case (Opus-R1-like 1,098 tokens/query at Kimi-R1 queries/episode) reaches ~$98. Cap $150, team-approved 2026-09-13. The action vocabulary includes DROP on purpose (post-R1 harness fix; kept going forward). OpenAI reserves max_completion_tokens against the TPM limit at request time, so API_WORKER_CONCURRENCY must fit the key's usage tier (see scripts/estimate_frontier_cost.py output).
_note_probe: Local single-process probe (scripts.run_pipeline --run-config). Model settings identical to run_config.r1_frontier.json (the R1-frontier Astra run) except spend_cap_usd (per-process hard stop sized to this probe) and max_in_flight.
